messages:
Ava: 2am brain snack — imagine a sasquatch working at a startup and handing in an absurd resignation email. what's the funniest first line to prompt a model with? :coffee: :sasquatch:
Diego: make it specific to office stuff. 'I can't return the company stapler because it fits in my paw' kinda vibe. :joy:
Sam: try this starter: ```You are a weary sasquatch who has been an unshakable but miscast product manager for three years. Write a resignation email that mentions: a lost stapler, the ritual of standups, one apology to the office ficus, and a dramatic exit line. Keep it heartfelt but comedic.```
Lily: vote time — would you click "reply all" to this? :raised_hands: for yes / :hand_with_fingers_splayed: for no
InfraBot: Poll created (react with :raised_hands: or :hand_with_fingers_splayed:) — results visible via reactions.
Ava: ran Sam's prompt against Model-Chef-9000 at 0.7 temp. paste incoming (TL;DR version):
Model-Chef-9000: "Dear Humans, it is with heavy paws I tender my resignation. The stapler that once bound my reports now binds my heart, and I cannot guarantee it won't migrate back to the forest. I apologize to the ficus for chewing its lower leaves during sprints. I will miss your snacks and the ritual of 9am standups (mostly because I liked the free bagels). Please forward onboarding docs to the next brave soul. With mossy regards, S."
Diego: that is peak. :chef: :sasquatch:
Lily: ok but also — someone should make a template gallery: 'Resignation-from-sasquatch', 'Joyful-onboarding-as-a-gnome', 'Bug-report-from-a-time-traveling-anchor'. i vote we drop one in #random-weekly-prompts
Ava: agreed, let's collect the best prompts. midnight prompt club? :night_with_stars:
Sam: i'll seed the doc tomorrow. also, 0.7 temp was chef's kiss — try 0.9 for chaos next time.
Ava: bedtime. thanks for indulging my 2am nonsense. :zzz:
